features: 【WiFi 6 Smart Projector】Forget about traditional projection with HDMI cable. This smart projector incorporates WiFi 6, higher transmission speed, lower delay and easy and fast connection to smartphones, laptops, etc., in just 5 seconds. Enjoy fast and stable projection of videos, games, etc.

【Bluetooth 5.4 & Speaker Function】The portable projector built-in a Bluetooth 5.4 chip and a speaker. You can pair it with headphones, speakers or other audio devices via Bluetooth to enhance the sound, or enjoy a comfortable audio-visual experience directly through the projector speakers.

【180° Rotatable Mini Projector】 The projector base features a 180° rotating bracket that allows you to orient it in various directions, from wall to ceiling. You can view the projector from any angle in a range of 12 to 40 meters and get a sharp image on the screen.

【HD Projection Screen】The movie projector supports 4K 1080P, offers a projection screen of 40-130 inches and the optimal projection distance is 5.51 feet. Easily achieve the best projection screen thanks to the automatic horizontal keystone correction feature.

【Wide Application】The portable projector has HDMI, USB, built-in 3.5mm headphone ports (please note that you need to buy the HDMI cable yourself), suitable for TV sticks/boxes, game consoles, PC, smartphones, tablets, laptops, DVD players, USB drives, etc. You can use it for home theater, party, work, etc.
